trainer/30526.htm.text: Blacksmith Brunon: Hail and well met! I'm Blacksmith Brunon of the Black Anvil Guild . What business brings you here today?

links.text: Ask about the Black Anvil Guild.
Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

trainer/30526-1.htm.text: Blacksmith Brunon: Always happy to boast about our guild! While the other races were still throwing bamboo spears and swinging stone axes, our ancestors had mastered bronze tools and begun crafting steel weapons. Only the best craftsmen are allowed entry into the Black Anvil Guild. We, in turn, hav…

trainer/30526-noteach.htm.text: Blacksmith Brunon: I told you I was busy. Stop bothering me! Off with ye, now!

Q00005_MinersFavor/30526-03.html.text: Blacksmith Brunon: You again! What is it this time? I already gave you the Miner's Pick that Bolter ordered. Take it to him at the Strip Mine and leave me in peace!

Q00005_MinersFavor/30526-01.html.text: Blacksmith Brunon: Who are you you and what do you want? I am too busy to waste time with young idlers... Bolter's order, you say? And who is Bolter? Start talking sense or get out of my shop!

Q00108_JumbleTumbleDiamondFuss/30526-01..text: Blacksmith Brunon: ... This dice...? Where did you get this? Thanks anyway. Is there anything else you want to tell me about? Star Diamond? Oh, you mean the fool's jewel that I won from gambling yesterday! I don't care about you people, but I won that jewel through a fair dice game. The jewel is mi…

links.text: Say you will take the task

Q00108_JumbleTumbleDiamondFuss/30526-03..text: Blacksmith Brunon: Have you recovered all my jewels? Not yet? Have you forgotten about our Contract? I promised that if you restore all my jewels that the goblin brigand lieutenant took from me, I would give you the diamond back that I won from your friend, Torocco. You have to find my ten Aquamari…

Q00108_JumbleTumbleDiamondFuss/30526-04..text: Blacksmith Brunon: Good job! You found all my jewels! Thank you! Now, as we agreed, I will give your friend's diamond back. Take this Gem Box ! You don't need to worry about anything. I've never opened it ever since I got it from your friend.

Q00108_JumbleTumbleDiamondFuss/30526-05..text: Blacksmith Brunon: Why have you come back? You got the Gem Box. What else do you need from me? Hurry up and give the diamond back to the owner.

Q00108_JumbleTumbleDiamondFuss/30526-06..text: Blacksmith Brunon: Woot?! Is that Murdoc's coal...? How did you...? Oh yeah! The treasure chests must have been mixed up! Haha...! How could it have...?! Hey, don't look at me.. Somehow the chest with diamonds got mixed up with the treasure chest of Warehouse Keeper Murdoc . Hahaha... ah nuts. Look…

Q00108_JumbleTumbleDiamondFuss/30526-07..text: Blacksmith Brunon: Look! I didn't mean it! I was not trying to deceive you! Take the letter I wrote to Warehouse Keeper Murdoc . Then, you will be able to get your Gem Box back.

Q00108_JumbleTumbleDiamondFuss/30526-08..text: Blacksmith Brunon: ... Look. I am very busy now... I don't know what you are up to, but can we talk about this later?

Q00213_TrialOfTheSeeker/30526-01.html.text: Blacksmith Brunon: Oh, a letter from Marina! She must be too busy to come herself. I've done a lot of business with her, but I still can't figure her out! I understand she's had a great past... Anyways, here's what she asked for. Be careful! It's fragile.

Q00213_TrialOfTheSeeker/30526-02.html.text: Blacksmith Brunon: Take this to Marina at once! Be careful, it's very fragile.
when: state STARTED; has items 2664; lacks items 2663

Q00347_GoGetTheCalculator/30526-01.htm.text: Blacksmith Brunon: What goes through your mind when you gaze upon the silvery moon? Have you ever dreamed of visiting that cold and desolate place? Just think of the strange and wonderful minerals there! Imagine the discoveries you could make! Many have tried to reach the moon but so far all have f…

links.text: "I don't want to go to the moon."

Q00347_GoGetTheCalculator/30526-02.html.text: Blacksmith Brunon: When you have developed more skills I would like to talk to you about a project I've been working on. This quest can only be undertaken by a player of level 12 or above.)

Q00347_GoGetTheCalculator/30526-13.html.text: Blacksmith Brunon: Ah, you're back! Did you bring the new model Calculator ? Not yet? Why not? As I said, you should check with the Trader Guilds . I am sure they brought it into the village. If you keep looking you will find it. Surely you know by now that the guilds you should check with are the …

Q00347_GoGetTheCalculator/30526-14.html.text: Blacksmith Brunon: Hello again! Have you brought the new model Calculator ? I guess that was too much to hope for. I see that you are still investigating. Remember, there are two trade guilds you should talk to: the Silver Scale Guild and the Golden Wheel Guild . Please hurry and get the Calculator…

Q00347_GoGetTheCalculator/30526-15.html.text: Blacksmith Brunon: You came back! Have you brought the new model Calculator ? Oh, well, keep looking for it.

Q00347_GoGetTheCalculator/30526-09.html.text: Blacksmith Brunon: Oh... So this the new calculator! Good work. I will reward you as promised. You don't mind if I test it first, do you? Wait just a moment... Hm... Is this how it you use it? . . . Argh! What's this? This is...! And they call this "new"? Ha ha ha! I'm sorry, but I have no use for …

Q00005_MinersFavor/30526-02.html.text: Blacksmith Brunon: Ugh! That smell! Do you have a week-dead ferret in there? Ohh... Wait! Bolter! I remember him now. He placed an order last week, didn't he? Well, well! Here is the Miner's Pick he wanted. Take it -- and get that vile-smelling thing away from me!

Q00005_MinersFavor/30526-04.html.text: Blacksmith Brunon: No, I don't remember any Miner Bolter. Perhaps you're thinking of another blacksmith. In any case, I don't have time to play detective. Shoo!

Q00108_JumbleTumbleDiamondFuss/30526-02..text: Blacksmith Brunon: All right. I will explain this quest to you, so listen carefully. This happened few weeks ago... ... When I was delivering jewels that I got at the Mithril Mines, I was attacked by goblin brigands... I barely got out alive, but they took all the jewels I was delivering... I fired…

Q00347_GoGetTheCalculator/30526-03.htm.text: Blacksmith Brunon: Oh, well, I will have to look elsewhere for a volunteer for the moon mission. I do have another task you might be interested in. Any project this large requires a lot of support on the ground. I realize this is rather sudden, but would you mind taking a test to see if you qualify…

Q00347_GoGetTheCalculator/30526-04.htm.text: Blacksmith Brunon: Ah, you are smarter than you look! Was that too easy? Come to think of it, mathematical skills aren't at all important for the position I was thinking about. You don't seem to understand my way of thinking very well, and I hesitate to trust you with the expensive equipment. If we…

Q00347_GoGetTheCalculator/30526-05.htm.text: Blacksmith Brunon: I bet you plan to publish a new, world-shattering theory... Turn the mathematical world on its head... Am I right?... I am having serious doubts about working with you.

Q00347_GoGetTheCalculator/30526-06.htm.text: Blacksmith Brunon: Ha! Too much for you, eh? Don't worry, you passed the test... Why do you look so surprised? Your willingness to admit that your calculation skills are weak tells me that you and I share a common bond. I have tried and tried to reach to moon, and every time, total failure! Whoa! W…

links.text: "Brunon, you're the one who said it."

Q00347_GoGetTheCalculator/30526-07.htm.text: Blacksmith Brunon: Oh, yes, so I did! I believe the reason my previous missions to the moon have not been successful has been due to calculation errors. Any miscalculation in atmospheric resistance, engine burn, or any thousands of other factors inevitably leads to disaster. I need to get the lates…

Q00347_GoGetTheCalculator/30526-08.htm.text: Blacksmith Brunon: Thank you! Please go and get it immediately. I have heard that the new model Calculator was brought in by one of the Trader Guilds . That would be good place to start, wouldn't it?

Q00347_GoGetTheCalculator/30526-10.html.text: Blacksmith Brunon: Good choice! I hope you get some use out of it. By the way, if you change your mind, come back to see me! I am still looking for a volunteer for my 18th mission to the moon!

Q00347_GoGetTheCalculator/30526-11.html.text: Blacksmith Brunon: Ah, yes. It is refreshing to see someone who knows the value of money. By the way, if you're ever interested in going to the moon, come back to see me!

Q00347_GoGetTheCalculator/30526-12.html.text: Blacksmith Brunon: Thank you for completing the task to the best of your ability. You can either take the calculator or accept 1500 Adena.

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).

common/duals_01.htm.text: Needless to say, in order to make a Dualsword, you first need two swords. They can be either Regular weapons, Standard weapons or Rare weapons. Regular weapons can only be combined with other Regular weapons, Standard weapons can only be combined with other Standard weapons, and Rare weapons can on…

common/crafting_01.htm.text: [Create ingredient item] Our Blacksmith Guild creates items at a very reasonable price. You may entrust your precious materials to our Blacksmiths. They have a long-standing tradition of integrity. We will do our best to serve you. The creation of the ingredient for A-grade items is the pride of ou…

links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change. General Skill Enchanting This method of enchanting requires 1 [Giant's Codex] and a certain amount of SP and adena to complete. If the enchant attem…
